claims.claim: The IMF raised its 2026 UK GDP growth forecast to 1.3 percent.
claims.episode_span: The International Monetary Fund raised its 2026 UK GDP growth forecast to 1.3 percent.
claims.source_title: Healey should ‘stay the course’ and repair UK finances, says top IMF economist
claims.supporting_quote: In a fillip for the chancellor, who is poised to arrive in Bangkok later this week, the IMF has upgraded its growth forecast for the UK this year, but expects a modest slowdown in 2027 as higher energy prices take their toll.

claims.claim: CEATEC 2026 opened with a record 246 startup companies and universities plus 194 overseas firms.
claims.source_title: AI and latest digital technologies on display at CEATEC show in Chiba
claims.supporting_quote: A record 246 startup companies and universities, along with 194 overseas firms, are taking part in the four-day technology event.

claims.claim: The National Institute for Space Research recorded 540 new hotspots in 48 hours in Amazonas state.
claims.source_title: Brazil blames human action for the fires sweeping the Amazon
claims.supporting_quote: The Brazilian government has blamed deliberate human action for the wave of fires in Amazonas state, where 540 new hotspots were recorded in 48 hours, more than half of those detected in the whole of October 2025, according to the National Institute for Space Research.
